We are looking for a CRM & Lifecycle Manager to join Hårklinikken as we continue to develop and grow our global ecommerce business.

We operate six Shopify sites across the US, UK, EU, Denmark, Iceland and the UAE, with the US representing our largest growth market and subscriptions playing a central role in our model.

You will own the CRM and lifecycle journey across our markets, building the communication, flows and experiences that help turn first-time clients into long-term relationships. From onboarding and treatment support to subscriptions, repeat purchase, loyalty and win-back, you will help clients stay engaged, consistent and cared for throughout their journey with us.

Working hands-on in Klaviyo and Recharge, you will use data and customer insights to understand where clients engage, where they drop off and what helps them stay. You will continuously test and improve the lifecycle journey, with a particular focus on the first 90 days and subscription retention.

Success in this role means improving 90-day retention, increasing the number of subscribers who stay for at least three deliveries, strengthening repeat purchase rates and growing CRM revenue across markets.

You will track cohorts and LTV by market and share what you learn, helping those insights shape our wider acquisition and ecommerce activities.

Primary Relationships

You will report to the Global Director of Ecommerce and work closely with the Senior Ecommerce Manager as part of our ecommerce team in Copenhagen.

You will also collaborate closely with Brand, our clinics and our Client Care Teams, particularly around campaigns, the client journey, loyalty and client feedback.

You will work closely with our Content Marketing Manager, providing clear briefs for CRM campaigns and customer communications.

Key Responsibilities

• Klaviyo. Build and run flows, segments, campaigns and SMS across six markets, working with our Content Marketing Manager who develops copy from your briefs.

• The first 90 days. Own the onboarding journey for new clients, helping them start their treatment right and stay with it.

• Subscriptions in Recharge. Manage sign-ups, retention, churn and win-back, testing what helps subscribers stay longer.

• Consultation to treatment. Develop booking reminders and post-consultation flows that help turn consultations into lasting treatments, both in our clinics and at home.

• Loyalty, reviews and client feedback. Work closely with our Client Care Team to understand where clients get stuck and what brings them back.

• The campaign calendar. Coordinate the campaign calendar so CRM, the site and paid media go live at the same time with the same message.

Core Competencies

This role requires strong CRM and lifecycle experience combined with a hands-on, structured and analytical approach. You are comfortable working with data, understanding customer behaviour and turning insights into actions that strengthen retention.

You keep many moving parts on track and care about the client, not just the open rate. You understand how to grow retention through value rather than discounts, and you know when one email is one too many. You don't need to tick every box to be the right fit. We would love to hear from you if you bring strong CRM or lifecycle experience, a customer-focused mindset, a genuine interest in building relationships that last and supporting our mission

What You Bring:

• 3-5 years of experience in CRM, retention or lifecycle marketing, ideally within DTC ecommerce.

• Strong hands-on Klaviyo skills, with experience building flows, segments and templates yourself.

• Experience with subscriptions, ideally Recharge.

• A track record of delivering results that you can demonstrate through data.

• Confidence working with data, with the ability to read a cohort and understand what to test next.

• Fluent English.

It is an advantage if you also have:

• Experience working across several markets or Shopify storefronts, ideally including the US.

• Experience with a premium beauty, wellness or personal care brand with a regimen or subscription model.

• Experience with loyalty or review platforms.

• Proficiency in a Scandinavian language.

Who Are We?

Founded in 1992 in Copenhagen, Hårklinikken is a leading scalp and hair health clinic with more than 30 years of experience. We help clients achieve optimal scalp health and long-lasting hair gain, combining expert guidance with clean and gentle products formulated to support healthy hair growth.

Our approach began with Hårklinikken’s founder and lead researcher, Lars Skjøth, who developed a diagnostic, consultation-based approach centred around understanding each client’s individual scalp and hair needs. Today, The Hårklinikken Method brings together decades of expertise with the personalised care that has been at the heart of Hårklinikken from the beginning.

Clients come to us in different ways, whether through a consultation or by discovering and purchasing our products online. Through virtual consultations or in person at our clinics in New York, Beverly Hills, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Dubai and Reykjavik, our Hair Specialists combine their expertise with an individual assessment of each client’s scalp, hair, lifestyle and environment to create a personalised regimen designed around their specific needs.

However their journey begins, we are here to guide and support our clients along the way. From helping them find what is right for their individual needs to supporting them in achieving the best possible results, we want every client to feel confident, understood and cared for throughout their Hårklinikken journey.

We’re on a mission to help as many people as possible achieve fuller, stronger, healthier hair with products that are powered by science, perfected by experts and proven by over 100,000 clients.

What We Offer

• A new team, where you shape how we work from day one.

• Full ownership of CRM and subscriptions across six markets.

• Short decision paths in an owner-led company.

• Close collaboration with our clinics, where the treatment starts.

• A real work-life balance, with flexibility in how you plan your day.

• An international team and modern clinics with a strong focus on quality and aesthetics.

• Growth opportunities in a safe work environment.

• Pension, holiday allowance and discounts on our products and treatments.

The role reports to the Global Director of Ecommerce and is based on site in Copenhagen. It is a permanent, full-time position, starting as soon as possible and ideally no later than 1 March 2027.

Questions? Contact Emma Cronwall Trampedach at +45 3133 5432.

Equal Employment Opportunities

We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences, and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results.

jobs.description:
Supply Chain Launch Manager for global launch projects

Would you like to help orchestrate the global launch of new products, representing our supply chain throughout the entire launch projects?

Join a global group of skilled supply chain professionals and follow new products from early development all the way to market – as your input will ensure that we deliver the best products to people with intimate healthcare needs.

“WE play a key part in planning and executing successful launches – and we are a valued voice in the process, allowing us to set a clear direction,” explains Head of Supply Chain Launch, Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen.

Join our highly experienced Launch department

Together, we are 7 colleagues, responsible for supply chain activities related to bringing new and innovative products to market within Chronic Care and Wound Care products. A good part of our time, we spend working with our factories in Hungary, Costa Rica, and soon Portugal.

“As we are each dedicated to different projects, discussing what we’ve learned with each other is very important to us. And we’ll be there to make sure you get to ease into the position,” says Daniel.

Ensure that supply chain is covered in every project

As part of the Coloplast global supply chain, you will find yourself in the middle of a web of stakeholders working towards launching new Chronic Care and Wound Care products. Here, you will be dedicated to specific projects, acting as supply chain lead or subject matter expert, representing the voice of supply chain and making sure supply chain is on track for launch.

Specifically, you will be the subject matter expert from supply chain, staying up to date on project progression. Moreover, you will plan the launch and make sure that systems, manufacturing, stock levels, etc. are ready for launch. And when you meet a bump in the road, you will figure out solutions with the project team.

From early project development until post-launch, you will:

•    Influence project decisions and direction early, to avoid supply chain risks

•    Drive the supply chain plan with manufacturing sites, balancing project deliverables and commercial considerations to launch on time

•    Produce launch scenarios in collaboration with other departments and ensure alignment with the rest of the organization

•    Coordinate activities at our production sites and flag supply chain risks

•    Make sure systems, such as planning, base data and distribution, are ready for launch

•    Follow up on delivery performance of newly launched items after launch

Your work may take you traveling roughly 2 weeks per year, primarily to our factory in Hungary. However, you will have a say on how the trips are planned, so they will fit with the rest of your life.

Supply chain knowledge and stakeholder management skills

In this role, you must be able to work cross-functionally, using your good stakeholder management skills to incorporate a wide range of input from across the business. Also, you can work with limited supervision in your projects, representing the voice of supply chain, making decisions, and setting a direction for your area.

Finally, we imagine that you:

•    Have a degree in supply chain or engineering

•    Have some experience, either within supply chain or logistics and a good conception of production processes

•    Possibly have some experience working in projects, allowing you to consider both commercial and supply chain perspectives

•    Are good at Excel and at adapting to new systems

•    Are fluent in English

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Head of Supply Chain Launch,

Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen on DKDAAR@coloplast.com. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Do you want to help shape the next generation of AI-powered business capabilities and are you motivated by turning business opportunities into intelligent agentic products?

How you will make an impact

You will join a dedicated product team responsible for the Net Revenue Management (NRM) Commercial Intelligence Platform and its growing portfolio of pricing, promotion, forecasting, and AI-enabled capabilities. Working closely with commercial stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineers, and data specialists, you will:

• Build a deep understanding of pricing, promotions, demand drivers, and commercial decision-making within Net Revenue Management.

• Design and develop statistical, econometric, and machine learning models that generate actionable business insights.

• Develop and operationalize forecasting, pricing, and promotional effectiveness models in production environments.

You have hands-on experience with Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and modern AI tooling. You enjoy solving real business challenges and working at the intersection of business, data, and technology. You understand that successful solutions require strong statistical foundations, trusted data, and robust engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings:

• Strong experience with Bayesian hierarchical models using tools such as PyMC, Stan, or NumPyro, combined with solid statistical inference and model validation practices.

• Strong econometrics and causal inference expertise, including price elasticity modelling, endogeneity challenges, and deriving reliable insights from real-world commercial data.

• Strong Python and SQL skills, combined with experience deploying and maintaining models through automated pipelines, monitoring, testing, versioning, and MLOps practices.

• Practical experience with machine learning approaches such as XGBoost, LightGBM, and forecasting techniques for demand and baseline prediction.

• Optimization techniques and decision modelling using tools such as OR-Tools, Pyomo, or Gurobi.

• Advanced causal inference methods such as Causal Forests, Synthetic Control, Bayesian Structural Time Series, DoubleML, or EconML.

• Time-series forecasting approaches such as state-space models or Prophet.

• Databricks, Spark, Azure, and modern cloud-based data platforms.

• Retail and consumer datasets, or an MSc/PhD within Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

What do we offer?

This position is based in Aarhus, Denmark or Gdańsk, Poland, with an expectation of 50% office presence. You will work alongside skilled product teams, architects, engineers and data specialists and can help shape the future of AI-powered commercial capabilities within one of Arla’s strategically important business domains. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, competitive salary and benefits, and opportunities for professional development in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

Would you like to join us?

If you are ready to help turn AI opportunities into real business value, we would love to hear from you. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidate is found.

For more information, please contact Andreas Therkildsen, Manager, IT Product Architect, athec@arlafoods.com.

jobs.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection between commercial strategy, transformation and execution. Do you enjoy setting the direction and then rolling up your sleeves to make it happen? Join 3Shape’s CCO Leadership Team and shape how a global MedTech leader grows. We are looking for someone who isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo and brings a healthy disruptive edge to how things are done.

About 3Shape

3Shape started with a simple idea: to make 3D scanning better. We applied it first to the hearing industry and then to dentistry, and today our scanning and CAD/CAM solutions help dental and hearing professionals treat more people, more effectively. Every second of every day, a 3Shape scanner is in use somewhere in the world. We are 2,200+ colleagues of 45+ nationalities, headquartered in central Copenhagen at Kongens Nytorv.

Our commercial organisation is approximately 1,000 people strong and delivers our products to customers in 29 countries across Europe, the Americas and Asia. Our flagship products include a mixture of hardware and software; TRIOS intraoral scanners, the Dental System CAD software and the 3Shape Unite platform.

Your new role

As Senior Director, Commercial Excellence & Commercial Strategy, you report directly to our SVP of Commercial (CCO) and act as a close sparring partner. You sit on the CCO Leadership Team with the leaders of Global Customer Success, Global Marketing and our three Regional VPs, and you lead a team of Commercial Excellence Managers, transformation agents, project managers and data and reporting specialists.

You own the commercial strategy for Dental Clinics, DSOs (dental service organisations) and Laboratories, and you build Commercial Excellence into a global function that turns strategic choices into growth across markets.

Leading leaders and running Commercial Excellence should come naturally to you. The real stretch in this role is driving a transformation and professionalization of the commercial organization with the aim of lifting topline growth.

You will work side by side with colleagues at our Copenhagen headquarters in Denmark, in an office-based role, and you will regularly travel to spend time with our great people in local sales hubs and meet customers at leading dental events around the world.

What you will do

Commercial strategy & transformation

• Own the three-year commercial strategy and the annual commercial strategy cycle, linked to budget, targets and business plans.

• Turn the strategy into a roadmap with clear owners, milestones and KPIs, and keep execution on track.

• Lead the CCO transformation portfolio and challenge how we get most impact across segments, markets, channels and new offerings.

• Build alignment across global functions, regions and markets, including through our Country Manager forum.

Commercial Excellence

• Define and scale the global Commercial Excellence operating model, from customer potential and territory management to sales plays and tools.

• Turn market, customer and competitor insight into decision-ready recommendations for the CCO Leadership Team.

• Set the CRM standard and the commercial performance framework together with IT, Data Management and Financial Planning & BI.

• Partner with Finance and Portfolio and Product Strategy (PPS) on pricing and discount governance, and enable go-to-market for new offerings.

• Drive launch excellence for new products and offerings, with a repeatable launch playbook, clear market readiness criteria and adoption KPIs that get new solutions into customers’ hands quickly across all markets.

What success looks like

• A three-year commercial strategy with clear priorities agreed in the CCO Leadership Team and linked to budget and targets.

• Commercial transformation delivering tangible impact with revenue growth, efficiency gains and capability uplift in priority markets, with learnings carried into the rest.

• Commercial Excellence established as a recognised discipline, with a strong team and a clear role across Commercial, Portfolio and Product Strategy (PPS) and Finance.

• CRM adopted to standard in all markets, and leadership decisions taken on a shared, current picture of market, customers and competitors.

• A proven launch excellence model in place, with new offerings reaching target adoption faster across markets.

Who you are

You are an experienced senior commercial leader with documented results from comparable roles. You hold a master’s degree in economics, business or similar, and you bring:

• Experience leading leaders and engaging, inspiring and developing people.

• A track record of owning and driving commercial strategy from within the business, rather than as an external advisor, with measurable results to show for it.

• Deep Commercial Excellence experience, including shaping and growing the function in a fast-growing organisation. MedTech experience is a plus.

• Experience leading complex, cross-functional transformations with executive stakeholders.

• Executive presence and the courage to challenge senior leaders and established ways of working.

• International experience from a global matrix organisation.

What 3Shape offers

• Real influence on how a global MedTech leader grows, a premium brand guided by innovation and customer focus.

• A strategic mandate across regions to shape our global commercial approach, with real room to influence and make decisions.

• A seat on the CCO Leadership Team and high visibility with senior leaders across 3Shape.

• A role as the CCO’s personal sparring partner on the commercial path forward.

• Global scale and impact across 29 countries, and the opportunity to lead a strong, international team.

• An attractive healthcare package, daily breakfast and lunch from our own chefs, and plenty of social clubs and activities.

• Modern offices in central Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv and Nyhavn.

Application process

• To apply, click "Apply now" and attach your CV including a short motivation in one document.

• Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About Apylon And The Opportunity

Apylon is building the intelligent revenue management platform for European healthcare. Billions of euros flow between hospitals and insurers through fragmented, manual workflows — a maze of rules, conditions and requirements.

We believe this is a machine learning and automation problem disguised as financial operations.

Apylon is backed by experienced operators and top-tier investors in healthcare and fintech. Our team draws on experience from Zendesk, Pleo, Wawa Fertility, Sibill, and some of the largest multi-country hospital groups in Europe.

As a Founders Associate, you’ll work directly with the founding team on the highest-priority challenges facing the company. This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to all aspects of building a venture-backed startup — from strategy and operations to customer success and fundraising.

Delivering healthcare is hard. Getting paid for it shouldn’t be.

You’ll be responsible for

• Building and improving internal processes and operations as we scale.

• Supporting fundraising efforts — preparing materials, coordinating with investors, and managing due diligence.

• Wearing many hats — from data analysis to customer calls to operational firefighting.

• Helping build the company culture and team as we grow.

Who you are

• Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

Bonus points

What Apylon offers

Working at Apylon means embarking on a highly ambitious mission to rebuild the financial infrastructure of European healthcare. We’re already live with leading private hospitals, processing thousands of invoices, proving that complex payer rules can be turned into code - powering transparent, automated, and intelligent revenue operations.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

• Positive Attitude

**JOB SUMMARY

**

• Manage and delegate audit deliverables across quarterly, interim, and yearly cycles.

•

• 
You'll cut the work so the riskiest assumption reaches production first. Nothing we plan should take more than a week to reach production.

• 
You'll ship small changes to production continuously. We work trunk based with feature toggles, and roll changes out gradually so they can be turned off without a new deploy.

• 
You'll write the tests as part of the change. There is no test phase and no one else whose job is to find your bugs.

You'll watch how each change behaves in production and improve it in the next deploy when the evidence says so.

• 
You'll change infrastructure through code, the same way you change everything else.

Claude Code is rolled out across the engineering team, and agents are a normal part of how we build.

Most of the detailed decisions in a working day are yours. You make them in a tight loop with an agent, guided by your team's documented product principles, design system and technical decisions. When something falls outside them, you pull in the right person.

You'll keep the context in your repositories current, so the next developer or agent starts from how the code actually works.

• 
You're responsible for what an agent produces in the same way as for code you wrote by hand.

Your team runs its part of the product in production, including availability, scalability, security and bugs. You'll be part of that, including when something breaks.

You'll make sure problems show up in monitoring before customers notice them.

• 
You'll keep dependencies current and fix small issues as they appear, a day at a time, rather than saving them up for a big project.

Working toward outcomes

• 
Your team works toward outcomes, and you'll know which outcome your work serves and whether it moved.

Work is done when the outcome moved or when we decided to stop. When we stop, we stop cleanly, with nothing half built left behind.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Trial Supply Manager/ Senior Clinical Trial Supply Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about clinical trial supply management? Do you have experience within GMP/GDP-regulated environments and managing complex clinical trial supply chains?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Clinical Trial Supply Manager.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

As Clinical Trial Supply Manager at Ascendis Pharma, you will be responsible for managing selected areas of the Clinical Trial Supply Chain in collaboration with internal and externally stakeholders. The Clinical Trial Supply (CTS) department comprises three closely collaborating teams: CTS - Coordination, CTS-IRT and CTS - Preparation & Handling.

We are seeking a passionate Clinical Trial Supply Manager to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in managing the clinical trial supply activities across Phase 1-3 studies. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be part of a dedicated and highly experienced Clinical Trial Supply department comprising 12 colleagues. The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will depend on your experience and may include:

• Coordinating internal CTS trial meetings and activities and collaborating with internal departments incl. CMC, Trial Management, QA, IT, and Regulatory Affairs

• Forecasting, planning, and facilitating the supply of IMP for clinical trial supplies, including managing IMP Packaging and Labelling activities, packaging design, label text development, and planning of packaging runs

• Managing IRT setup, incl. IRT specification, UAT preparation and execution, Go-live and close-out, as well as managing IRT system changes after Go-live

• Managing IMP distribution from CMOs to clinical sites incl. direct-to-patient (DtP) shipments and management of temperature excursions during storage at depots and clinical sites and during shipments

• Managing drug accountability activities, including returns, reconciliation and destruction

• Participating in meetings with CMOs, suppliers and vendors, trial teams and Investigator Meetings

• Maintaining documentation in the QMS and eTMF, including reviewing and preparing trial-related instructions and manuals

Qualifications and Skills:

Ideally, you hold a relevant academic degree in pharmacy or a related field and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in clinical trial supply management or a GMP/GDP-regulated environment.

Furthermore, you have:

• Proven experience in managing complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders

• A strong understanding of regulatory requirements

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office

• Fluency in written and spoken English and Danish

Key competencies:

You are a collaborative and quality-focused team player with a structured and analytical approach to your work. You are adaptable, take ownership, and have a can-do attitude. You thrive in a fast-paced, informal environment where priorities may change and close collaboration is key.

Travel: 2–10 days per year

Office: Denmark, Hellerup, Tuborg Havn

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Sara Østergaard, Director Clinical Trial Supply PM Team at sbo@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

In Technical, you will join a team of talented and welcoming colleagues.

You will be responsible for the safe, efficient, and cost-effective technical management of assigned vessels. This includes ensuring compliance with international maritime regulations, oil major requirements, and company standards. The role supports onboard teams in maintaining vessel integrity, managing repairs and overseeing dry-docking activities, while prioritizing safety, environmental protection and operational reliability.

Key responsibilities include

• Manage vessel performance: Ensure assigned vessels remain safe, reliable, compliant and operationally ready through effective technical oversight and planned maintenance

• Lead repairs and dry dockings: Plan and oversee repairs, upgrades and dry-docking projects, managing safety, quality, cost and schedule

• Maintain compliance: Prepare vessels for class and statutory surveys, audits, SIRE inspections and oil-major requirements, ensuring timely closure of findings

• Strengthen reliability: Monitor machinery condition, recurring defects and equipment performance, driving corrective and preventive actions

• Control budgets: Manage vessel operating and dry-docking budgets, balancing technical requirements with cost-effective solutions

• Support onboard teams: Work closely with Masters and Chief Engineers, conduct vessel visits and provide practical guidance on technical and maintenance matters

• Respond to incidents: Coordinate technical support during breakdowns and emergencies, including troubleshooting, repairs, investigations and follow-up actions

• Collaborate across functions: Partner with Marine Operations, Crewing, Procurement, HSSEQ and Commercial teams to support safe and efficient vessel operations

• Drive improvement: Share lessons learned and contribute to fleet-wide improvements in safety, reliability, efficiency and technical standards

Are you part of the solution?

At Maersk Tankers, you can come as you are and be among people who will expand your horizon. As our new Technical Superintendent, we do, however, expect that you can contribute with the following:

• Degree in Marine Engineering or equivalent; Class 1 marine Engineer Certificate is preferred

• Minimum 3-5 years of shore-based experience as Technical Superintendent or sailing experience as Chief Engineer on oil/chemical and gas tankers

• Strong knowledge of tanker operations, marine engineering systems, PMS and international regulations

• Experience with dry-docking, major repairs and budget management

• Excellent communication, problem-solving and leadership skills

• Ability to travel internationally and attend vessels, sometimes on short notice

You have technical expertise in tanker operations and have a safety and compliance mindset. You are able to prioritise effectively and make informed decisions in a dynamic environment. You have analytical skills and understand budget and cost control. You collaborate effectively with teams and manage stakeholders with transparency and respect.

For further information about the role connect with Santosh Khosla at Santosh.Kumar.Khosla@maersktankers.com.

Job Title: Senior Director, Corporate Procurement

Department: Corporate Procurement

Location: Bagsværd, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**Shape the future of a diverse, business-critical portfolio, strengthen an experienced leadership team and raise the bar for global category excellence. You will challenge established approaches, unlock cross-category opportunities and use commercial judgement, strategic partnerships and AI-enabled insights to make our procurement decisions smarter, faster and more valuable.

As our new Senior Director, you will set the global procurement direction for the services and technologies that enable Novo to operate, innovate and grow. You will lead one of our three global category clusters called Corporate Services. The cluster covers Professional Services, External Workforce and Digital Solutions with approximately DKK 20 billion in annual spend.

**What You’ll Do

**Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Procurement (reporting to CFO), you will join Corporate Procurement Management and lead the Corporate Services cluster through three experienced team leaders (two Directors and one Associate Director) and their 23-person teams in Denmark, who drive category management and strategic sourcing. You will work closely with our Category Management Support function and our Global Business Services teams in Bangalore (India), which manage tactical sourcing.

**You Will

**

• Lead through others: Set direction, empower your leaders and build a culture of accountability, honest feedback, development and constructive challenge.

• Drive global category excellence: Set the cluster’s strategic direction, connect business priorities with market opportunities and enable ambitious category strategies that deliver measurable value.

• Unlock cross-category opportunities: Find synergies across the three categories and challenge how we access expertise, deploy technology and partner externally to strengthen competitiveness, flexibility and innovation.

• Shape demand and business opportunities: Anticipate evolving needs, challenge established commercial and delivery models, and build the senior partnerships and sponsorship to turn opportunities into results.

• Advance AI-enabled category excellence: Use technology, data and AI to deepen market intelligence, accelerate decisions, automate lower-value work and raise the impact of category management.

• Strengthen strategic supplier ecosystems: Build partnerships that bring innovation and critical capabilities while improving commercial value, performance, sustainability and resilience.

**Who You’ll Work With

**Corporate Procurement is a global strategic function with an ambitious cost, innovation and value agenda. We manage Novo’s indirect spend, supplier base and global Source-to-Pay processes and systems, with teams in Bagsværd, Bangalore and Boston and category and sourcing managers across the globe.

We bridge business priorities with market opportunities and supplier capabilities, using market intelligence, AI and automation to move faster, decide better and deliver greater enterprise value.

You will partner with colleagues across Corporate Procurement and senior stakeholders Enterprise IT, People & Organisation, Legal, Finance and other business areas, as well as regional procurement colleagues and senior executives at strategic suppliers.

As part of Corporate Procurement Management, you will also help shape the wider procurement agenda, build and grow the future leadership of the organisation, strengthen cross-category collaboration and build a more intelligent, agile and high-performing organisation.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an accomplished procurement and people leader with deep domain expertise, strategic perspective and strong business partnering skills. Above all, you succeed through others: setting clear direction and enabling experienced leaders and experts to make sound decisions, grow and deliver together.

You have a clear view of how procurement creates enterprise value and use market insight, supplier capabilities and internal expertise to shape opportunities with the business.

**To Succeed, You Will Bring

**

• Solid experience in category management and global strategic procurement.

• A strong record as a leader of leaders, delivering results, developing experienced category leaders and experts, and driving high engagement organisations.

• Deep category expertise across complex indirect spend, with strong credibility in at least one of Professional Services, External Workforce or Digital/IT and sound understanding of the others.

• Proven ability to partner with and constructively challenge senior executives, aligning a global matrix organisation around shared outcomes.

• Experience leading complex negotiations, strategic supplier relationships and transformation, balancing value, quality, innovation, agility and risk.

• Experience leveraging shared services and specialist capabilities in global procurement operating models to maximise strategic capacity and performance.

• Strong analytical judgement and financial acumen, with an understanding of how AI, automation and advanced analytics improve procurement intelligence, productivity and decisions.

You combine curiosity, courage and commercial judgement, and coach others through difficult decisions with clarity, care and integrity.

**What You Can Expect

**You will lead one of our most diverse and strategically important global portfolios, influencing how Novo accesses critical expertise, technology and supplier innovation. With ~DKK 20 billion in annual spend, an experienced leadership team and direct access to senior decision-makers, you will have the scale and mandate to make a real difference.

Our Corporate Procurement organisation has high ambitions for category excellence and enterprise value, and we value leaders who bring new perspectives, challenge conventional thinking and raise the bar for themselves and their teams.

Guided by the Novo Way, we create focus and speed through clear priorities, simple ways of working and decisive action. We care for our people, show respect and never compromise on safety and ethics.

As part of a strong procurement leadership community, you will broaden your enterprise perspective, develop other leaders and keep growing as a senior executive.

**Start now

**Ready to shape global category excellence, develop outstanding leaders and connect business ambition with market opportunity?

Apply for the Senior Director, Corporate Procurement role by November 22, 2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV.

For further information, please contact Executive Search Advisor Kristoffer Baadsgaard at +45 30 77 56 05.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Position, purpose & impact:

**We're looking for an experienced Senior People & Culture Business Partner to be the main P&C partner for our Go-To-Market organization, with a special focus on our US team. You'll be the go-to HR expert for the US, so you need solid, hands-on experience with US HR practices, benefits and systems.

Working closely with our CRO and GTM leaders, you'll strengthen performance, leadership and engagement across the business. You'll also support organizational development, talent decisions and change initiatives. You'll be based in our Copenhagen office, support US colleagues across time zones and travel to the US about every second month. Your work will help build the high-performing, trust-based culture that drives Queue-it's growth.

**Your toolkit:

**

• Several years of experience as an HR Business Partner in a senior role, including organizational. development and performance management.

• Previous hands-on HR experience supporting employees and leaders in the US.

• Solid knowledge of US employment practices, employee relations, benefits and HR administration.

• Practical experience with US HR systems and providers, such as TriNet or similar.

• Confidence to coach and challenge leaders while building trusted advisory relationships.

• Strong facilitation and communication skills across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Experience with stakeholder, project and change management.

• An analytical mindset that turns people insights into clear business recommendations.

• Experience supporting global organizations across cultures and time zones.

• Willingness to work US hours when needed and travel to the US about every second month.

**The role in action:

**

• Partner with our CRO and GTM leaders on performance management, talent development and organizational effectiveness.

• Act as the go-to HR expert for our US organization, advising on employment practices, benefits, employee relations and HR administration.

• Give practical guidance on policies and compliance, and bring in external legal experts when needed.

• Coach and support managers through people decisions across the whole employee lifecycle.

• Facilitate performance dialogues, feedback processes and development conversations that lift individual and team performance.

• Run leadership development initiatives and employee development programs across GTM.

• Drive engagement initiatives and help leaders act on employee feedback, together with the wider P&C team.

• Support organizational changes and make sure communication and stakeholder alignment stay strong throughout.

• Contribute to P&C projects and strategic initiatives that support business priorities.

• Spend regular time with our US team, both remotely across time zones and on-site in the US.

**Why join the Queue

****Your Copenhagen base

**Most of your time will be at our Vesterbro office in Copenhagen, Queue-it's largest office and global headquarters. The space is designed for both teamwork and focus, with open work areas, quiet rooms and dedicated spaces for deep work. You'll also spend regular time in the US, travelling there about every second month to work side by side with our US team. In between visits, you'll stay closely connected to them across time zones.

**How We Work

**At Queue-it, you’re trusted to work in a way that suits you best, supported by a strengths-based approach and a flat hierarchy inspired by Danish work culture. You’ll be part of a global team with colleagues from 40+ nationalities, where diverse perspectives, open dialogue, and cross-cultural collaboration are part of everyday work.

**Community and everyday life

**We make time to connect, with regular social activities, ping pong, foosball, daily snacks, fresh fruit, great coffee, and access to a subsidized canteen in the building. It’s a workplace that balances professional growth with a strong sense of community.

**What We’re About

**At Queue-it, we help leading brands like Ticketmaster, Sky Mobile, and Peach Aviation navigate their busiest days with confidence. Our virtual waiting room keeps websites running smoothly during high-traffic events, creating fairer, more reliable online experiences for billions of users.

We’re also a global team of 40+ nationalities working across Denmark, the U.S., South Korea, Australia, and Japan. We believe in trust - in the digital experiences we protect and in the culture we build together.

Here, we take a strengths-based approach, encouraging people to do what they naturally do best. You’ll join a supportive environment where individuality is valued and collaboration matters.

And yes, we like to have fun. From monthly events to cultural celebrations and learning initiatives, we make time to connect, recognize one another, and enjoy the Queue.

We are empowered by trust and strengthened by people.

You will analyse and elaborate requirements coming in from our customers via Delivery and help evolve and design a standard solution to support customer’s needs.

Using AI

What we offer
